complexity_ledger.narrative: CL-02 -- A PRICE STOPS BEING ENTAILED BY THE SHAPE OF THE REMOVAL. THE HEADLINE IS THE UNINTERESTING DIRECTION AND IT IS REPORTED FIRST: NOTHING CAME BACK NON-ZERO. Every historical removal with a published before-table was re-priced with the corrected instrument, on the entailed side and the measured side, and the total is 0 priced results. `RM-01-RF-1` is still PRICED and is still the only price this project has. WHAT WAS BROKEN. `RM-05` withdrew `RM-03`'s "first PRICED removal in this project's history": the round's own control -- `is_control` true, `removed_by` "nothing", `gap` "NONE, on purpose" -- returned the headline verdict, and that row was missing from the four-row output the report printed as three. For every fault all of whose killing nodes lie in a file the removal deletes, `ENTAILED-SURVIVES` follows from `git show` alone and no other verdict is reachable. Both halves were reproduced at 10cf11a BEFORE a line was changed and the transcripts are in the tree (`specs/results/scorecards/close-the-loop/GOAL-price-means-something/parent-10cf11a-same-commands.txt`). THREE CHANGES, ALL IN ONE NON-PRODUCT FILE. (1) `EXTINCT`: a fault whose habitat the removal deleted has no post-removal artifact to be seeded into, so there is nothing left to detect. It is NOT a price and NOT a zero -- it is a refusal to measure, and the capability such a removal costs is measured by nothing here. The wording is the repository's own, from `residual_faults.toml`'s `[[not_seedable]]` row, which stated the distinction and never computed it. (2) A declared control is `CONTROL-EXCLUDED` in every mode and can never be a priced result -- but it is still PRINTED, in its own block outside every denominator, because RM-05's defect was a control row GOING MISSING, and a tidier table would reproduce it exactly. (3) `--head` is resolved with `git rev-parse --verify` before any verdict is computed; an unresolvable head used to make every killing node look deleted and price the whole table at exit 0. THE CARE THAT KEPT IT HONEST. Habitat is read from the EDIT OPS, never from the declared path list. `SM-GM-I3` edits `scripts/gap_probe_instrument.py` with `op = "add_file"`, and that path is absent at `bf0fb29` BECAUSE THE MUTANT CREATES IT. A path-list rule would have called it extinct and made SM-03's removal look cheaper on a bookkeeping detail. Guarded by a test. MEASURED ALTERNATIVES REJECTED. Rendering `EXTINCT` as `FREE` or counting it as a zero -- it asserts safety on evidence that does not exist. Dropping control rows from the table -- that IS the RM-05 failure. Fixing `RM-05-DF-02` (`price` returns PRICED over an all-INERT after-table; still reproduces, filed as CL-02-DF-02) -- that change can only turn a PRICED into a refusal, which makes past removals look CHEAPER, and making it in the commit that reports a re-priced history is the tuning this goal fails a ticket for. Pinning `RECORD`'s floating `head = "HEAD"` (filed as CL-02-DF-01) -- it moves `audit`'s ten sealed rows in the same commit as the measurement taken against them. NOTHING WAS ADJUSTED AFTER A RESULT WAS SEEN. BOUNDS THAT TRAVEL WITH THE VERDICTS. `EXTINCT` is file-granular: a mechanism RENAMED rather than deleted reads EXTINCT and is not extinct. It is an upper bound on extinction exactly as `ENTAILED-SURVIVES` is an upper bound on the price. Both bounds are in the row's own `why`. NO NEW GATES. Nothing in the repository invokes the pricer, no close path consults it, and its exit code refuses nothing about the design. The served surface is untouched at 6,319 bytes and 9 rungs -- the card was not edited. SUITE, WITH ITS TREE. 2 failed, 1492 passed in the real checkout wt-epic-close-the-loop-CL-02 at feature/CL-02 (NOT a `git archive` tree). The two are the inherited deliberate reds, neither repaired: RM-06-DF-01, and `test_nothing_in_the_repository_invokes_the_pricer`, which now names TWO narrative documents because this epic's charter mentions the pricer. It was not allow-listed and not deepened -- no new mention was added outside `specs/`. `denominator_rule`: 1479 -> 1494 collected, failures unchanged; +11 is the numerator rising (this ticket's tests, all of which fail at 10cf11a), +4 is the denominator rising through `test_spec_yaml_valid.py`'s parametrisation over the ticket workspace `open ticket CL-02` scaffolded. No test was removed, skipped or weakened. R1. The demonstrated failing input is real, not a fixture: the sealed RM-03 before-table with `--head deadbeefdeadbeef`, which at 10cf11a printed four ENTAILED-SURVIVES rows at exit 0 and now exits 2 with no table.

ticket.objective: NO REMOVAL IN THIS REPOSITORY CAN CURRENTLY BE PRICED, because the normal shape of a removal is the shape that always returns ENTAILED-SURVIVES. RM-05 withdrew the previous epic's headline to prove it: the round's own control, declared is_control true with gap 'NONE, on purpose', RETURNED THE SAME VERDICT, and that row was MISSING from the four-row output the report printed as three. For every killing node inside a deleted file the verdict follows from git show alone and no other verdict is reachable. Give entail a verdict meaning EXTINCT; EXCLUDE DECLARED CONTROLS from the verdict table so a zero-gap row can never appear as a priced result; validate --head; and re-price at least one historical removal, REPORTING A NON-ZERO LOUDLY if one appears. RM-01-RF-1 and SM-04-GM-T1 are the known positives -- an instrument that cannot reproduce both is not working.
